titre.sous: in, on, at, by, until, for, since

bulles.etiquette: IT CONTINUES, THEN IT STOPS AT SIX

q.lu: Please submit your expense report ------- Friday.

etapes.texte: **by** = a deadline. **until** = it continues up to that time

phrases.texte: In, on and at go from big to small. In, for months, years and seasons: in May, in 2026.
phrases.dit: In, on, and at, go from big to small. In, for months, years and seasons: in May, in twenty twenty-six.

phrases.texte: On, for days and dates: on Monday, on June 3rd.
phrases.dit: On, for days and dates: on Monday, on June third.

phrases.texte: At, for an exact time: at nine, at noon.
phrases.dit: At, for an exact time: at nine, at noon.

phrases.texte: Now, the classic trap: by, or until?
By gives a deadline. Send the report by Friday means: on Friday, or before.
phrases.dit: By, gives a deadline. Send the report by Friday, means: on Friday, or before.

phrases.texte: Until means the action continues, and then stops. The office is open until six.
phrases.dit: Until, means the action continues, and then stops. The office is open until six.

phrases.texte: For goes with a duration: for three days. Since goes with a starting point: since Monday.
phrases.dit: For, goes with a duration: for three days. Since, goes with a starting point: since Monday.

phrases.texte: And during goes with an event: during the meeting.
phrases.dit: And during, goes with an event: during the meeting.

phrases.texte: Now, a TOEIC question. Please submit your expense report, blank, Friday.
A: until. B: by. C: at. D: in.
phrases.dit: Answer A. until. Answer B. by. Answer C. at. Answer D. in.

phrases.texte: At goes with an exact time, and in with a month or a year. Friday is a day. So C and D are wrong.
phrases.dit: At, goes with an exact time, and in, with a month or a year. Friday is a day. So C and D are wrong.

phrases.texte: Submit is one moment. It does not continue. So until is wrong.
phrases.dit: Submit, is one moment. It does not continue. So, until, is wrong.

phrases.texte: B is correct. Friday is the deadline: submit your expense report by Friday.
Remember. One: in May, on Monday, at nine.
Two: by is a deadline. Until means it continues up to that time.
phrases.dit: Two: by, is a deadline. Until, means it continues up to that time.

phrases.texte: Three: for plus a duration, since plus a starting point.
Now practise with the questions below.
phrases.dit: Now, practise with the questions below.
